summary: Curved Swann Road kerb with no-stopping signs and homes 8 m away.
reasons: No Stopping Any Time signs both ways
Homes 8-9 m along most of it

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 8 m from the south kerb at 10-12 m, 37 m, 52 m and 9 m at the end; others 11-25 m.
drivers.access_and_room: South side is a thin planted verge against fences; the lane is the only place to stop on the bend.
drivers.traffic: Swann Road is a through road with a bend and a side-street junction at the start.
drivers.convention: Two No Stopping Any Time signs (6.8 m and 12 m from the kerb line). A few cars park on the north side only.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs on the stretch
sun_shade: Dense garden trees shade the south verge from 30 m on; the start is open.
